findings.title: CV folds are anchor-grouped but not protein-disjoint; validation/test share 0 proteins
findings.detail: 92.8% of validation records have a partner present in other folds and 56.9% of partners are validation anchors. HGB stackers (F1, F2) with partner-level features can learn partner propensities that transfer across folds but not to test, biasing selection toward them.
findings.fix: Before any test scoring, re-run stage-6 stackers and F3 with protein-disjoint folds as a sensitivity, or state in the report that F1/F2's CV advantage may not transfer. Do not re-fold after seeing test.

findings.title: Adaptive 208-variant search makes finalist CV composites optimistic
findings.fix: Disclose variant count and stage-wise choices; report test delta as the estimate, CV as best-of-208.

findings.title: Composite masks F2's weak nDCG@10 (CV +0.0025 vs published form +0.0108)
findings.fix: Report per-metric deltas for every finalist, not only the composite.

findings.title: Published-variant in-sample sanity check in run_search.py is commented, not asserted
findings.fix: Assert theta_all of the published spec equals the published selected weights (it does in the current log).

findings.fix: Fix docstring; optionally assert URI/index equality on load (holds today: 0/11,174 mismatches).
